ideas.title: Last-Second Comeback Win
ideas.trend: Last-play college football finish (38-34 game recap)
ideas.why_now: 20000+ searches today for yesterday's scores, led by a 38-34 recap of a game played on 17 October.
ideas.mapping: A high-scoring finish decided at the end sets a near-fail ending with two seconds left, a speed-up toward the end and a hurry caption.
ideas.prompt: Concept: 'final-play comeback'. A hard narrow-centre level on a medium-sized board with 8 blocks. The ending is a near-fail: one wrong move where the blue block gets stuck behind a red block, then it is solved with two seconds left. The tempo speeds up toward the end. Hook: "Down to the final seconds". The hurry caption is "Clock's running out!" and the result caption is "Comeback complete". Use only red, blue and yellow blocks on a dark theme. 30 seconds.

ideas.title: Week Six Gameday Rush
ideas.why_now: Fans are searching for today's Week 6 games and starting quarterbacks.
ideas.mapping: Gameday energy sets a fast speedrun tempo, a clean finish where every block leaves one after another, and team-style black-and-gold colours.
ideas.prompt: Concept: 'Sunday gameday speedrun'. A medium-difficulty level on a 7x7 board with 7 chunky blocks, using only yellow, orange and dark green blocks. The background behind the board is black and gold. Fast tempo. It ends in a clean win with no mistakes: first move the orange block aside, then they all leave one after another in a cascade. Hook: "Gameday speedrun. Ready?". The fast-finish caption is "Touchdown pace". 30 seconds.

ideas.title: Pumpkin Spice Puzzle Break
ideas.why_now: This week's event listings talk about fall fests, a growing amount of pumpkin-spiced everything and dropping temperatures.
ideas.mapping: A cosy fall mood sets warm autumn colours, a calm relaxing tempo and a satisfying clean finish.
ideas.prompt: Concept: 'a cozy autumn puzzle break'. An easy, spacious level on a small board with 6 blocks and plenty of empty cells, using only orange, yellow, red and dark green blocks. The background behind the board is pumpkin orange and warm brown. Calm, relaxing tempo. It ends in a clean win where one move frees everything. Hook: "Cozy fall puzzle time". The result caption is "So satisfying". Optional note: attach a pumpkin sticker for the top-right corner. 40 seconds.

ideas.title: Can You Finish Strong?
ideas.why_now: Runners are getting ready for this weekend's 23rd annual Grand Rapids Marathon, and searches for it are rising.
ideas.mapping: A long race that comes down to the finish sets a longer level that speeds up near the end and stops as a cliffhanger, asking the viewer to finish it.
ideas.prompt: Concept: 'the last mile'. A hard level shaped like long lanes on a big board with 9 blocks, mostly long bars. It plays at a normal tempo that speeds up toward the end. It ends on a cliffhanger: the video stops with two blocks left and asks the viewer to finish. Hook: "Can you finish strong?". The end-card title is "Your move". The background behind the board is green and white. 45 seconds.
